categories.name: ESP32-C3 Sensor Hardware & Processing
categories.description: Covers the target board, sensor pin assignments and initialization, DHT22 and MPU6050 measurements, orientation calculation, and sensor-related configuration limits.
requirements: The firmware shall target the ESP32-C3-DevKitM-1 board.
The firmware shall use GPIO2 as the MPU6050 I²C SCL signal.
The firmware shall use GPIO3 as the MPU6050 I²C SDA signal.
The firmware shall use GPIO1 (board pin 10) as the DHT22 data signal.
The firmware shall read temperature from the DHT22.
The firmware shall read humidity from the DHT22.
The firmware shall read MPU6050 acceleration and report the acceleration for each axis in m/s².
The firmware shall calculate gyroscope-derived orientation angles in degrees.
The firmware shall use accelerometer-assisted correction to reduce drift in orientation, including tilt axes where applicable.
The firmware shall handle sensor read failures without terminating the measurement loop.
The firmware shall not use accelerometer correction as an absolute yaw reference, and shall allow the Z orientation to drift over time.
The firmware shall treat the MPU6050 I²C address, sensor calibration procedure, and orientation-filter parameters as unspecified by this PRD.
The firmware shall initialize the MPU6050 before acquiring its sensor data.
The firmware shall initialize the DHT22 before attempting to read its measurements.

categories.name: Wi-Fi Connectivity & Credential Management
categories.description: Covers Wi-Fi and Blynk secret configuration, credential protection, and continued measurement and recovery behavior during network interruptions.
requirements: The firmware shall receive Wi-Fi and Blynk credentials as configuration secrets.
Passwords and authentication tokens shall not be committed to a public source repository.
The firmware shall keep credentials out of source files intended for sharing or version control.
The firmware shall handle network disconnections without terminating the measurement loop.
The firmware shall reconnect to the network and resume publishing when possible after a connectivity interruption.

categories.name: Blynk IoT Integration & Data Publishing
categories.description: Covers Blynk template configuration and Wi-Fi-based cloud connection, publishing cadence, virtual-pin mappings, and the boundary with the existing dashboard.
requirements: The firmware shall use Blynk Template ID TMPL3VjCwAzY1 and template name ESPInterface.
The firmware shall connect to Blynk IoT over Wi-Fi using the supplied configuration.
The firmware shall publish all eight sensor values to their assigned Blynk datastreams every two seconds.
The firmware shall publish temperature to Blynk virtual pin V0.
The firmware shall publish humidity to Blynk virtual pin V1.
The firmware shall publish accelerometer X to Blynk virtual pin V2.
The firmware shall publish accelerometer Y to Blynk virtual pin V3.
The firmware shall publish accelerometer Z to Blynk virtual pin V4.
The firmware shall publish gyroscope orientation X to Blynk virtual pin V5.
The firmware shall publish gyroscope orientation Y to Blynk virtual pin V6.
The firmware shall publish gyroscope orientation Z to Blynk virtual pin V7.
The firmware shall maintain the two-second sampling and publishing cadence during normal operation.
The firmware shall send values to the existing dashboard and datastreams; it shall not create the dashboard.
